description: This source file defines the RegistrationService interface in Java, specifying methods to assert device registration and authorization status within a device management system, including handling of tenants, devices, gateways, and span context for tracing.

classes.name: RegistrationService
classes.description: Interface for device registration and authorization assertions, including methods to verify device registration status and gateway-based device assertions, with support for tracing via OpenTracing spans.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks if a device is registered and enabled for a given tenant, invoking the result handler with the outcome. Throws NullPointerException if parameters are null.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Default method invoking the primary assertRegistration method; includes span context for tracing.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks if a device is registered, enabled, and optionally if a gateway authorizes acting on behalf of the device, utilizing span for tracing.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Default method with span context, invokes the core method.
